expected_behavior_change: Every distinct formal Admin publish is assigned a strictly increasing Cloud canonical publish time.
Admin outbox delivers every queued formal publish oldest to newest instead of collapsing to one revision.
Rxx/revision remains diagnostic metadata only and never decides freshness.
Every ADMIN_CONFIG_AVAILABLE notification forces SMT to pull the same canonical Admin endpoint.
SMT atomically applies canonical Admin data by publishedAt plus fingerprint and keeps existing local LKG until a newer canonical publish arrives.
SMT ACK identifies the exact canonical fingerprint and publishedAt that was applied.
Admin and SMT human-facing status use publish/apply/readback time vocabulary instead of Rxx truth.
Reconnect, focus, pageshow and visibility recovery reuse the same canonical pull path without interval polling.
non_goals: No Order, Pricing, Payment, Print, Keeta, Customer, SMM or Owner authority change.
